description: holon-coherence lacks a CI package import-cycle ratchet to block new cross-layer dependency cycles.
goal: Add a fast AST-based package import-cycle ratchet test in tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py that scans src/holon_coherence/ top-level subpackages and their internal imports, locks the current baseline cycle pair edge counts in the live repository, fails CI if any new package import cycle is introduced or any existing cycle's edge count increases, and passes cleanly when edge counts are equal to or lower than baseline so cycle-breaking changes can land and tighten the baseline. Include unit tests using synthetic AST trees/modules verifying both cycle regressions fail and improvements pass. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py and uv run task lint pass. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Automated ratchet enforcement prevents feature and security changes from silently introducing cross-package import cycles.
acceptance_criteria: CI fails if any new package import cycle is introduced or if any existing cycle's edge count increases; breaking cycles passes cleanly and lowers the ratchet baseline.
tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py passes uv run pytest tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py and uv run task lint with zero docstrings and zero comments.
